This suggests that your tenure may not align with the stability the organization seeks. Many employees who feel secure in their roles typically do not receive outside opportunities. Lastly, your experience in the current organization is also in the 1-5 year range, which is again less common among those predicted to stay.

These factors collectively indicate a potential lack of long-term commitment, which the organization may interpret as a risk when considering promotions.
